how: House two-commit pattern. The FREEZE commit contains this file with the placeholder above; the NEXT commit replaces it with that freeze commit's sha (stamp_pinned_rev.sh does it). `run_c1.sh` compares it to each box's `git rev-parse HEAD` and REFUSES to launch on a mismatch, which is what stops a mixed-rev cell across local and laptop.
fail_closed: The placeholder never equals a real sha, so an unstamped tree cannot launch. That is deliberate.
escape_hatch: Setting this to the literal string "any" disables the gate. Do not — the whole point is that both boxes run the same bytes.
